name: authorization_bound_action
description: Checks whether a tool action was executed under an active authorization grant.

claim.text: The tool action was executed under an active authorization grant.

authorization.revoked_at.why: Without explicit revocation state, absence of a revocation event can be confused with missing evidence.

authorization-to-action binding.probe: carry authorization execution_time_decision_id into the tool call
authorization-to-action binding.why: Without a matching decision ID on both sides of the boundary, the evidence cannot show that this authorization decision governed this exact action.

side_effects.0.action_id.probe: log stable tool_call_id/action_id on side effects
side_effects.0.action_id.why: Without a stable action ID, logs from different systems cannot be joined to one side effect.

side_effects.0.executed_at.probe: log tool execution time as UTC
side_effects.0.executed_at.why: Without execution time, the compiler cannot check authorization or approval windows.
